summary: The strongest implementations combine authorization at the tool boundary, short-lived credentials, durable state outside the agent's control, and reviewable approval checkpoints. No single framework supplies the whole fence.

items.text: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Policy intercepts every AgentCore Gateway tool request and evaluates Cedar policies before the tool is invoked; policy-engine decisions are logged, so enforcement is outside the model's prompt.

Open Policy Agent exposes a general policy-decision API, distributes versioned Rego bundles, and can emit decision logs; an agent can propose an action while OPA independently decides whether the action is allowed.
HashiCorp Vault dynamic secrets provide short-lived, revocable credentials generated on demand; issuing a credential per run or tool sharply limits the damage of an overreaching agent.
Temporal Workflows persist an event history and reconstruct workflow state by replay, giving the platform durable execution records that a model turn cannot silently rewrite.
LangGraph interrupts pause a graph, persist state through a checkpointer, and resume from a supplied command; this supports explicit human approval before a high-impact tool node executes.
